title: Observational Research Manager - Cardiovascular
description:
Job Title: Observational Research Manager - Cardiovascular
Job Location: Washington D.C., District of Columbia, United States
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full-time
Job Seniority Level:
HOW MIGHT YOU DEFY IMAGINATION?
You’ve worked hard to become the professional you are today and are now ready to take the next step in your career. How will you put your skills, experience and passion to work toward your goals? At Amgen, our shared mission-to serve patients-drives all that we do. It is key to our becoming one of the world’s leading biotechnology companies, reaching over 10 million patients worldwide. Come do your best work alongside other innovative, driven professionals in this meaningful role.
Observational Research Manager
Live What you will do
Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will be working with multiple teams to generate real world evidence supporting a wide variety of business needs. The increasing demand for real-world evidence (RWE) from regulatory and reimbursement authorities makes observational research a key component of drug development and commercialization. Amgen's Center for Observational Research (CfOR) is a global organization with an industry-leading analytical capability that generates RWE to support business needs across a product’s lifecycle.
CfOR scientists partner with internal team members and industry experts to design, conduct, interpret and publish observational research that informs decision-making from the early development of a molecule to the design of clinical trials and the safety and efficacy of Amgen medicines. CfOR studies include but are not limited to evidence generation regarding the frequency and distribution of disease, the clinical burden of disease, the natural history or clinical course of disease, the design of clinical trials, treatment cost and utilization patterns, and the safety and effectiveness of therapeutic interventions.
In this role you will have responsibilities for research activities on product-facing teams in the therapeutic area of cardiovascular disease. A CfOR Manager is recognized as a strong scientific contributor and is a first or contributing author for papers in peer-reviewed journals, abstracts for scientific congresses or for internal reports that enhance the company’s mission.
Key Activities include:

• Manage descriptive epidemiologic studies to characterize the incidence/prevalence of disease in US, EU, Asia, and emerging market countries

• Manage research projects involving the analysis of multiple types of data including medical claims, electronic health records, and prospective observational cohort studies

• Provide safety research support across the life cycle of Amgen products, supports the development of risk management plans, and implements pharmacovigilance studies

• Conduct literature reviews and prepares research reports and scientific manuscripts

• Stay abreast of the latest developments in the field of observational research and drug development

• Promote awareness, understanding, and use of observational research methods

• Communicate scientific information to a variety of audiences

Win
What we expect of you
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek has these qualifications.

• Master's degree and 2 years of scientific experience Or

• Bachelor's Degree and 4 years of scientific experience Or

• Associate’s degree and 8 years of scientific experience Or

• High school diploma / GED & 10 years of scientific experience

Preferred Qualifications:

• Doctorate in Epidemiology or other subject with high observational research content

• Experience in cardiovascular disease

• Experience in the design, execution, and analysis of observational research studies within Pharmaceutical or Public Health setting

• Experience in research to support drug development

title: Principal PLM Configuration Manager
description:
The era of pervasive AI has arrived. In this era, organizations will use generative AI to unlock hidden value in their data, accelerate processes, reduce costs, drive efficiency and innovation to fundamentally transform their businesses and operations at scale.

SambaNova Suite™ is the first full-stack, generative AI platform, from chip to model, optimized for enterprise and government organizations. Powered by the intelligent SN40L chip, the SambaNova Suite is a fully integrated platform, delivered on-premises or in the cloud, combined with state-of-the-art open-source models that can be easily and securely fine-tuned using customer data for greater accuracy. Once adapted with customer data, customers retain model ownership in perpetuity, so they can turn generative AI into one of their most valuable assets.

About the team

The PLM team runs product data and configuration control for our AI systems and semiconductor hardware programs, sitting between Hardware and System Engineering, Silicon, NPI, Manufacturing Engineering, Supply Chain, and Quality. It owns the PLM platform, the change control board, the release schedule against NPI gates, and the EBOM to MBOM handoff into ERP for products spanning silicon, PCBAs, racks, thermal and power subsystems, cables, firmware, and enclosures. The team is small and each person owns a product line end to end, so you will hold decisions rather than route them.

About the role

The PLM Configuration Principal owns product lifecycle and configuration management at the product level - running PLM the way a technical program manager runs a program, not the way a helpdesk runs a ticket queue. This role is the single accountable owner for how a product's data is structured, released, changed, and audited from first schematic through end of life.

It is a dual-hat position. Roughly half is platform ownership: you hold administrator rights in the PLM system and personally configure object models, item and document types, BOM structures, lifecycle phases, change workflows, roles, and privilege masks. The other half is program execution: you chair the change control board, hold the release schedule against NPI gates, keep the EBOM-to-MBOM handoff clean into ERP, and unblock cross-functional decisions across Hardware/System Engineering, Ops PM, Supply Chain, Quality and Contract Manufacturer.

The environment is high-mix, fast-revision AI systems and semiconductor hardware - L5-L12 (silicon, active/passive components, PCBs, PCBAs, racks, thermal and power subsystems, cables, firmware, and mechanical enclosures) - where a single mis-scoped ECO can strand inventory, slip a build, or ship a non-conforming rack. Precision is the job.

Responsibilities

PLM Platform Administration & Configuration (~40%)

• Serve as the named functional administrator for the PLM application - configure and maintain object and subclass models, item and document types, attributes and page-three fields, autonumber schemes, lifecycle phases, revision and effectivity rules, and part numbering standards.

• Build and maintain change workflows (ECR, ECO, ECN, MCO, deviation and waiver, stop-ship, and NCMR routings) including approval matrices, escalation timers, notification rules, and conditional routing logic.

• Administer roles, privilege masks, and criteria-based access controls; enforce least privilege and segregation of duties across internal users, contract manufacturers, ODMs, and foundry or OSAT partners.

• Own the PLM-to-ERP and PLM-adjacent integrations at the functional level: EBOM-to-MBOM transfer, item and AML/AVL synchronization, change-order publication, and reconciliation of failed transactions. Partner with IT on middleware and API-level defects.

• Manage sandbox-to-production promotion, regression testing, patching and upgrade validation, and configuration documentation. Maintain a written configuration baseline of the PLM system itself.

• Build reports, dashboards, and saved searches that give leade

Priority Commerce is a leading financial technology company on a mission to deliver a personalized, easy-to-adopt financial toolset that accelerates cash flow and optimizes working capital for businesses. Our vision is to eliminate the barriers to unlocking revenue - empowering businesses to grow faster and operate smarter.
We achieve this through the Priority Commerce Engine, an innovative platform that combines payables, acquiring, and banking and treasury solutions. This unified approach allows businesses to streamline financial operations, reduce unnecessary costs, and uncover new revenue opportunities.
At Priority Commerce, we're driven by results. We expect our people tobe known for results- bringing expertise, momentum, and relentless focus to every challenge, helping our clients and each other thrive.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, Strategic Solutions to shape differentiated financial products and experiences for complex customer and market needs. This is a hands-on role for someone who can take ambiguous market and customer problems, understand the workflows behind them, and turn them into clear product propositions, requirements, and roadmaps. Named as the 2025 best mid-sized employer by Forbes, we are engaged in providing excellence in patient care, embracing multi-disciplinary education, and research with global impact. We foster a learning environment that values evidenced based practice, experience, innovation, and critical thinking. With 20+ hospitals, outpatient clinics, ambulatory care centers and outreach locations across the globe, we provide excellent care to children up to age 18 regardless of their family’s ability to pay or insurance status. Please click here to learn more about our locations.

The Workday Systems Analyst, HR International French) role will focus on Workday HR Administration, configuration, and support across the HCM workstreams for our international locations, including Canada (with emphasis on Quebec) and Mexico. The ideal candidate will have experience supporting complex, bilingual (English/French) HR environments and navigating regional compliance, tax, and benefits requirements-Quebec healthcare experience strongly preferred. • Administering configuration and maintenance of Workday Core HCM, Benefits, and Compensation modules for international entities, ensuring compliance with Canadian (including Quebec) and Mexican regulations.

• Managing business processes, eligibility rules, validations, and reporting structures tailored to regional HR practices and labor standards.

• Supporting local HR users with troubleshooting, data corrections, and guidance across HCM, ensuring adherence to bilingual documentation and audit requirements.

• Coordinating testing and implementation of Workday releases and enhancements that impact international HR functionality and country-specific processes.

• Partnering with HR leadership, HR Operations, and local HR teams in Canada and Mexico to align system design with local legislation, healthcare requirements, and internal governance policies.

Required Qualifications:

• Fluency in French (written and spoken) as well as English

• Strong knowledge of at least two of the following Workday modules: Core, HCM, Benefits or Compensation

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

• Bachelor's Degree

• Proficiency in Workday Studio, EIBs, Core Connectors, and integration frameworks.

description:
Make banking a Fifth Third better®
We connect great people to great opportunities. Are you ready to take the next step? Discover a career in banking at Fifth Third Bank .
ABOUT THE ROLE:
The Business Transition Senior Strategist serves as the primary wealth planning expert for high-net-worth clients and prospects, with a specialized focus on business owners and closely held entities navigating ownership transition events. This role partners closely with Wealth Management Advisors (WMAs), Commercial Relationship Managers, and Investment Banking partners to lead discovery, develop integrated wealth and business transition strategies, and support implementation across pre- and post-transaction phases.
The role contributes directly to client acquisition, retention, and overall client experience by delivering comprehensive planning solutions that align business transition outcomes with personal wealth, estate, and tax objectives.
Please see below for specific responsibilities and requirements for this role.
YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:
The responsibilities for this role are below; you may support projects of varying complexity based on skill and organizational priorities.

• Client & Prospect Engagement: Partner with WMAs and One Bank partners to acquire and retain key client relationships by delivering comprehensive wealth strategies, with a focus on business owners and transition opportunities.

• Business Transition Discovery & Planning: Work directly with business owners to assess transition readiness, identify key risks and opportunities, and develop customized transition strategies spanning pre- and post-transaction phases.

• Integrated Wealth & Business Strategy: Align business transition plans with personal wealth strategies, including estate planning, tax optimization, liquidity planning, and legacy goals.

• Wealth Planning Strategy: Lead development of integrated wealth plans across estate, tax, investment, risk, insurance, and cash flow planning disciplines.

• Research & Modeling: Identify planning opportunities and model financial and tax implications of business transition scenarios, including sale, transfer, or recapitalization strategies.

• Client Deliverables & Oversight: Coordinate preparation and review of client deliverables, including transition plans, financial models, and presentations.

• Strategy Implementation: Present recommendations and coordinate execution of transition and wealth planning strategies in partnership with internal and external advisors.

• Partnership & One Bank Coordination: Lead a coordinated team approach across Wealth Management, Commercial, and Investment Banking partners to deliver a seamless client experience.

• Thought Leadership & Education: Educate internal partners and clients on business transition strategies, trends, and considerations through presentations, materials, and external engagement.

• Leadership & Talent Development: Coach and mentor Analysts and Strategists to build capabilities in advanced planning and business transition advisory.

• Risk & Compliance: Operate within the Bank’s risk framework and ensure adherence to policies and procedures while acting in the best interests of clients and colleagues.

• Other Duties: Performing other duties as assigned, adapting to new tasks or shifts in priorities as necessary to support your team’s and the company’s mission.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

• Bachelor’s degree required.

• 10+ years of experience in wealth planning, business advisory, investment banking, legal, accounting, or related professional services environment supporting business owners.

REQUIRED SKILLS:
Qualified candidates will possess an advanced degree of proficiency (typically from 10+ years of experience), in:

• Wealth & Transition Planning Expertise: Advanced knowledge of estate, tax, investment, and business transition planning concepts.

• Client Advisory Skills: Strong consultative approach with excellent communication and presentation capabilities.

title: IT Automation Engineer
description:
ABOUT US

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The IT Platform & Automation team builds and runs Legora’s identity, device and SaaS systems, working with Workplace Technology, Information Security and business teams to keep them reliable as Legora grows.

As an IT Automation Engineer, you’ll own Serval and find automation opportunities independently and in partnership with your peers. You’ll also partner with People Technology on HRIS integrations and automation. You’ll build workflows using automation platforms and AI agents, verify their effects in connected systems and read generated code when it helps you troubleshoot.

Our stack includes Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, Serval and Lumos, with Fleet for Apple device management. Automation is the main focus, with occasional employee support and troubleshooting.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

- Own Serval: manage its day-to-day operation, configuration and integrations. Keep workflows reliable and documented so teammates can support them and know who owns each part.

- Find work worth automating: identify and deliver opportunities independently and in partnership with your peers. Assess which are worth pursuing and take them through rollout and maintenance.

- Build workflows and integrations: use automation platforms and AI agents for onboarding and offboarding, access provisioning, SaaS administration and keeping data consistent across systems.

- Support People systems integrations: work with People Technology to build and test integrations between our HRIS and other business systems.

- Build AI-enabled services: help employees find information and complete approved actions. Set permissions, approval steps and fallbacks for uncertain answers or failed actions.

- Plan and deliver changes: compare approaches and explain the tradeoffs in reliability, complexity, cost and employee experience. Coordinate dependencies with system owners and use staged rollouts with appropriate recovery steps.

title: Partner Success Manager - Via Student Transit
description:
Via is using technology to transform transportation around the world. From changing a single person’s daily commute to reducing humanity’s collective environmental footprint - we’ve got huge goals.

As a Partner Success Associate on the Via Student Transit team, you’ll be on the ground floor of one of our fastest-growing verticals, working to bring safe, efficient, and flexible transportation to students across the U.S. This role blends strategic relationship management, operational data analysis, and consultative problem-solving. You will serve as a trusted, empathetic advisor to superintendents and transportation directors - understanding their needs and challenges, ensuring smooth program performance, driving service expansions, and driving long-term renewals in one of our fastest-growing business verticals.

We’re looking for a customer-first , self-starting team player who thrives in ambiguity, communicates clearly and effectively, and is excited to roll up their sleeves and help accelerate the growth of a high-impact, mission-driven business. 

What You’ll Do

• Build Trusted Partner Relationships : Serve as the primary point of contact for school district leadership, transportation directors, and operators, building durable, trust-based relationships through empathy, responsiveness, and a deep understanding of their priorities and challenges.

• Drive Service Quality & Efficiency : Analyze daily, weekly, and long-term transit performance data to understand what’s working, identify challenges, and provide actionable recommendations that improve routing, student safety, and operational efficiency.

• Lead Renewals & Expansions : Partner with customers to understand their evolving goals, negotiate complex contract renewals and service expansions, and grow year-over-year adoption and revenue across your partner portfolio.

• Champion Partner Needs Internally : Build strong internal partnerships with product, operations, deployment, and marketing teams, bringing the customer perspective to the table and advocating for improvements that meaningfully address partner and student needs.

• Communicate Across All Levels : Deliver clear, compelling presentations and operational updates to audiences ranging from school boards and superintendents to frontline transit staff, adapting your approach to meet each audience where they are.

• Self-Starter & Builder: You thrive in fast-paced, high-growth settings with ambiguity, taking ownership and solving problems proactively.

At Duffel, we’re rebuilding the infrastructure underpinning the global travel industry. Backed by top-tier investors (Benchmark, Blossom, Index Ventures, and Kima Ventures) and born out of Y Combinator (S18), we’re simplifying complex systems to build the future of travel

About the role

As Head of Technical Support, you’ll lead our team of Technical Support Engineers and take responsibility for the quality, effectiveness and development of the function.

You’ll build a team that combines strong technical investigation with clear, thoughtful customer communication. You’ll coach engineers, establish effective ways of working and ensure customers receive dependable support as their integrations grow in complexity and scale.

You’ll stay close to the work: reviewing investigations, helping with significant escalations and understanding where our products or processes create friction. Your impact will come from strengthening the whole team’s ability to resolve problems and turning what we learn from support into lasting improvements.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product, Partner Engineering, Partner Management and Travel Operations. Technical Support owns day-to-day API questions, troubleshooting and the customer support response to technical incidents. Partner Engineers own strategic technical relationships and solution architecture; Implementation Managers own implementation programmes.

What you’ll do

- Lead and develop the team. Set clear expectations, provide regular coaching and feedback, support career development and address performance issues constructively. Hire and onboard engineers as the team grows.

- Own support quality. Establish standards for technical investigation, written communication, case ownership and follow-through. Ensure customers understand what is happening, what comes next and who is responsible.

- Build a dependable support operation. Improve triage, prioritisation, queue management, handovers and escalation paths. Plan staffing and coverage around customer needs and agreed service commitments, with a sustainable workload for the team.

- Strengthen technical capability. Help engineers investigate API behaviour, interpret logs and request traces, reproduce integration issues and distinguish customer configuration problems from platform or supplier issues.

- Lead significant customer escalations. Coordinate the support response, establish customer impact and keep communication clear through to resolution. Work with Engineering on diagnosis and recovery, involving Partner Engineering where an issue creates a wider strategic risk.

- Make collaboration effective. Give Engineering actionable escalation reports with evidence, reproduction steps and impact. Work with Travel Operations on booking and supplier issues, and with implementation teams to ensure new integrations enter support with the context the team needs.

- Improve the product through support. Identify recurring problems and turn them into clear recommendations for Product and Engineering. Track whether fixes, documentation and product changes actually reduce customer friction.

- Make support easier to deliver. Develop troubleshooting guides, internal knowledge, customer documentation and useful tooling. Apply automation and AI where they improve accuracy, speed and access to help.

- Use evidence to guide decisions. Monitor response and resolution performance, ageing work, reopened cases, customer feedback and team capacity. Use that information to prioritise improvements and make clear recommendations about investment.

title: Backend Engineer - Coverage Team
description:
***For that position, we only hire in Buenos Aires🇦🇷 or Sao Paulo🇧🇷***
Who is Rollee

Rollee is a data platform that helps financial institutions make better risk decisions by accessing verified income, employment, and other alternative data directly from the source.
The way people work has changed. Income can now come from multiple employers, freelance work, gig platforms, or other sources, but many financial institutions still rely on traditional documents and credit data to understand someone's financial situation. This can make verification slow and fragmented and can leave people with non-traditional income profiles underserved.
Through a single platform, we connect to sources such as gig platforms, government tax portals, payment platforms, and other employment and income systems, then transform that information into structured, actionable data. Our customers use it to verify income and employment, improve their risk models, reduce fraud, and make better underwriting decisions.
Ultimately, our mission is to help build a financial system where people can be assessed based on a more complete picture of their real financial situation, regardless of how or where they work.
The role
We’re looking for a Backend Engineer to join our Coverage team.
The Coverage team is responsible for expanding and maintaining Rollee ’s ability to connect to employment and income data sources. You’ll work on challenging technical problems involving web and mobile applications, third-party systems, APIs, authentication flows, and data extraction.
We’re open to different levels of experience. You might be a junior engineer looking for an environment where you can learn quickly and take on increasing responsibility, or a more experienced engineer ready to own problems independently and contribute to technical decisions.
What matters most to us is your curiosity, problem-solving ability, and willingness to understand how systems work under the hood.
What you'll do

• Build, maintain, and improve integrations with employment and income data sources

• Investigate and resolve production issues

• Explore web and mobile applications to understand how they communicate with backend systems

• Work with undocumented or partially documented third-party APIs

• Debug authentication flows, network requests, and data extraction processes

• Write reliable, maintainable Python code

• Contribute to technical design decisions and help improve our engineering practices

• Improve the testing, monitoring, and automation of our systems

• Collaborate closely with engineers, Product Managers, Data Scientists, and other members of the team

• Take ownership of your work, iterate quickly, learn from feedback, and continuously improve

The scope and level of ownership will naturally depend on your experience.
What we're looking for
We’d love to hear from you if you have:

• Experience with Python

• Experience with web scraping, automation, data extraction, or similar technical challenges

• A good understanding of HTTP, APIs, and client-server communication

• Some experience exploring or debugging web and/or mobile applications

• The ability and curiosity to investigate systems with limited or incomplete documentation

• A strong problem-solving mindset and an interest in understanding how things work

• The ability to learn independently and get comfortable with unfamiliar technical challenges

• Good written and spoken English

We’re intentionally open to different experience levels, so you don’t need to tick every box. If you have strong technical foundations and enjoy solving unconventional engineering problems, we encourage you to apply.
Nice to have
Any of the following would be a plus:

• Experience with network debugging and traffic analysis

• Knowledge of authentication and authorization mechanisms

• Familiarity with application security, encryption, and common security protocols

• Experience reverse-engineering web or mobile application behavior

title: Systems Engineer
description:
About Infiterra
Join our mission to grow and transform the subscription economy by simplifying subscription service delivery.
Infiterra enables IT distributors, Managed Service Providers (MSPs), and telcos to succeed in the subscription economy. Our subscription commerce platform automates and unifies subscription workflows - from quote to bill- driving operational efficiency, billing accuracy, and scalable growth.
Recognized as a global leader in subscription commerce, Infiterra combines innovation, performance excellence, and trusted expertise to help partners transform and grow.
About the Role
We are hiring a mid-level Systems Engineer to take hands-on ownership of Infiterra ’s internal IT environment. The role combines Microsoft 365 and Entra ID administration, endpoint and systems management, employee IT support, access and security controls, and automation.
Your mission is to provide secure, reliable and increasingly automated corporate IT services to Infiterra employees. You will own day-to-day corporate IT operations while improving automation, identity and access management, endpoint management, employee lifecycle processes and service quality.
Moreover, you will have the opportunity to help evolve the function from largely operational support into a standardized, secure and increasingly automated internal IT service. This is not an L1 support position - support is part of the job, but the purpose of the role is to engineer and operate Internal IT as a scalable service.
Key Responsibilities
Identity & Access Management

• Keep corporate identities in Entra ID / Azure AD accurate, well-organized and easy to audit.

• Structure users, groups and roles so they map cleanly to how the business actually works.

• Deliver secure, low-friction MFA and SSO, backed by Conditional Access policies that keep unauthorized access out.

• Grant access the moment someone needs it, and revoke it the moment they no longer do.

• Keep privileged accounts tightly controlled, with no lingering or unused elevated access.

• Catch and correct access drift through regular reviews, before it becomes a risk.

• Act as Security's reliable partner in shaping and validating access policy decisions.

Employee Lifecycle

• Own the technical onboarding, role/access changes and offboarding process and run without gaps.

• Get every new employee productive from day one, with accounts, devices and applications ready before they start, and cut off access immediately once employment ends.

Endpoint & Device Management

• Keep every company laptop on the security baseline and current on patches, without employees ever noticing the effort behind it.

• Keep the device fleet fully accounted for, replace ageing hardware before it becomes a problem, and stay audit-ready on compliance reporting.

Corporate Systems & SaaS Administration

• Keep the internal Microsoft / Azure environment and core SaaS applications running reliably, with no unplanned downtime or configuration drift.

• Keep licensing spend, permissions and integrations accurate and well documented, so there's never confusion about who owns what.

Internal Support & Service Management

• Give employees fast, dependable help when something breaks, and make sure they always know exactly where to turn.

• Meet SLAs consistently, so waiting on IT is never the reason work stalls.

• Grow a knowledge base that resolves issues faster over time, instead of solving them from memory each time.

• Fix recurring issues at the root, so ticket volume trends down instead of repeating.

Security & Compliance Operations

• Keep access evidence, endpoint compliance, asset inventories and account lifecycle records ready to hand over for an ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audit.

• Run IT controls reliably day to day, giving Security confidence in the operational layer without having to manage it themselves.

Ideal Candidate Profile

• A Systems Engineer with hands-on Internal IT operations experience, comfortable across Microsoft

title: Creative Strategist (Freelance)
description:
Ce qu'on fait chez Ops Clean 🧪
Ici, on est en guerre contre une industrie opaque qui balance des produits toxiques dans les foyers depuis des décennies. Notre mission : rendre l'entretien de la maison sain, transparent et désirable. Et ça marche - on est passés de 0 à une marque DTC qui cartonne en passant de 0€ à 1M€ de CA en 2 ans.
Mais on ne veut pas juste vendre des sachets de lessive. On veut dominer la conversation sur la santé domestique. Et pour ça, on a besoin d'un cerveau créatif qui pense performance autant qu'organique.
On ne cherche pas quelqu'un qui exécute. On cherche un partenaire créatif qui comprend que chaque scroll est une bataille, que chaque hook a 3 secondes pour gagner, et que chaque euro dépensé en ads doit revenir multiplié.
Vos missions
Ce qu'on attend de toi 🫵
En tant que Creative Strategist, tu seras le lien entre notre expertise produit (santé, éco, transparence) et l'attention de millions de personnes sur TikTok, Reels et Meta Ads.
Stratégie créative organique : Concevoir des formats récurrents à haut potentiel viral - séries "debunk" de produits toxiques, vulgarisation clivante, tests en situation réelle. Tu penses en séries, pas en posts isolés.
Stratégie créative ads : Scruter nos comptes Meta/TikTok Ads, analyser ce qui performe, et proposer des recommandations créatives structurées et actionnables. Identifier les pépites organiques et les transformer en ads. Créer des itérations (variantes de hooks, CTA, angles) pour scaler nos campagnes.
Scripting & copywriting : Rédiger des scripts et briefs calibrés pour la performance - hooks puissants, structure narrative fluide, chaque mot compte. Tu briefes nos créateurs de contenu et nos monteurs jusqu'à la moindre virgule.
Supervision de production : Tu ne montes pas toi-même, mais tu diriges. Tu supervises les créateurs UGC et les monteurs pour garantir que le rendu final respecte ta vision stratégique et les codes natifs des plateformes.
Analyse & itération : L'idée de passer des heures dans les Business Managers Meta/TikTok pour comprendre comment créer LA prochaine créa banger doit te faire kiffer. Tu suis les métriques (Watch time, Hook Rate, ROAS, CPA) et tu pivotes en continu.
Vos compétences

• Expérience solide en stratégie créative ads, avec une compréhension approfondie des régies publicitaires Meta et/ou TikTok.

• Tu sais ce qui rend une vidéo virale - tu connais les algos, les formats, les tendances.

• Capacité à transformer des insights data en idées créatives percutantes.

• Plume affûtée : tu sais vulgariser des sujets techniques (santé, ingrédients, écologie) en messages simples, accrocheurs, parfois provoc'.

• Esprit analytique combiné à une forte créativité - tu es aussi à l'aise devant un dashboard que devant un script.

• Excellentes compétences en communication - tu sais briefer un créateur, challenger un angle, défendre une idée.

Avantages

• Impact réel : Tu bosses pour une cause qui a du sens - santé publique, transparence, écologie. Pas du bullshit marketing.

• Autonomie totale : Pas de flicage. On juge sur les résultats, pas sur les heures.

• Flexibilité : On est basés à Lyon, mais 100% remote c'est cool aussi.

• Opportunité de partenariat : Si tous les feux sont au vert, on est ouverts à discuter equity/vesting pour que tu sois vraiment dans la team Ops Clean .

• Accès direct au fondateur : Pas 12 couches de validation. Tu proposes, on teste, on itère.

⚠️ OBLIGATOIRE pour postuler
Pas de lettre de motiv' classique. Envoie-nous :

• Une vidéo d'1 min max pour nous expliquer en quoi tu es la personne la mieux placée pour ce poste. Utilise pour enregistrer et transmets le lien.

• 2-3 réalisations (organiques ou ads) dont tu es vraiment fier·e.

• Une petite critique de notre contenu actuel : quel angle "clivant" devrions-nous explorer demain ?

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. • Partner with the AI platform team to deploy your agents on the org's AI fabric. Make them discoverable, governed, and reusable across functions.

title: Data Scientist, Experimentation
description:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

At Tripadvisor experiences, the only thing we love more than travel is data. We slice it, we dice it, and we use it to empower our decision making.

 

What You will do:

As a Data Scientist on our experimentation team you will work with product teams across Viator to measure whether the changes they ship actually worked, defining the metrics that matter and making sure the decisions that follow are sound.

Part of your contribution is making experimentation easier for the teams you support, through reusable tooling, clear documentation and consistent practice. Viator sells experiences that travellers often book once a year, in a marketplace where supply is finite and shared, so you will be learning to navigate problems where the obvious analysis can give the wrong answer, with support from senior practitioners who have done it before.

You will:

• Design and analyse experiments end to end with the product teams you support, working directly with the Product Managers and Engineers who will act on the results.

• Turn product questions into testable hypotheses with pre-registered primary metrics, appropriate guardrails, and an honest view of what the available traffic can and cannot detect before the experiment starts.

• Define and instrument feature-level metrics, understanding how metric choice affects sensitivity, interpretation and the decision a team is trying to make.

• Investigate results properly, checking assignment integrity, exposure and data quality before conclusions are drawn, and treating a surprising result as something to diagnose rather than announce.

• Build reusable queries, tooling and templates and apply our shared protocols, so teams can run good experiments faster and with less rework.

• Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including inconclusive and negative results, with a recommendation attached rather than a table of numbers.

• Look beyond whether a change worked to why it worked, and flag when a result may not hold for other users, markets or time periods.

• Carry out analysis beyond experiments, including opportunity sizing, funnel and behavioural analysis, and observational measurement where randomisation isn't possible.

• Document hypotheses, designs, outcomes and decisions so results remain comparable and the organisation compounds what it learns.

• Grow your own depth in experimentation and causal inference, with review and mentorship from senior and principal data scientists.

 

Skills & Experience

 

• Experience: Solid experience in data science or a similar quantitative role, supporting and influencing product teams.

• Statistical & Experimentation Foundations: Sound understanding of experimentation beyond running it through a platform, including statistical power and minimum detectable effect, the difference between an inconclusive result and no effect, why peeking and post-hoc metric selection cause problems, and the common ways an experiment can be invalid.

• Technical & Modelling Expertise: Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with hands-on experience of statistical analysis and experimentation, and some exposure to statistical modelling or machine learning techniques such as regression and classification.

• Product Acumen: Ability to define, implement and operationalise product and feature-level metrics, with support from senior colleagues on the most complex c

Pokud máš dobré oko pro detail, jsi pečlivý/á a nebojíš se říct, když něco není v pořádku, tahle práce by Ti mohla sednout. Předchozí zkušenosti z kvality jsou výhodou, ale důležitější je pro nás spolehlivost, zodpovědnost a chuť dělat věci pořádně.

Co Tě u nás čeká

- Budeš kontrolovat kvalitu zboží při příjmu a hlídat, zda odpovídá našim standardům.

- Průběžně zkontroluješ produkty také během skladování a oddělíš zboží, které požadovanou kvalitu nesplňuje.

- Výsledky kontrol budeš jednoduše zaznamenávat, aby bylo vždy dohledatelné, co a kdy se kontrolovalo.

- Pokud narazíš na problém, předáš ho nadřízenému a pomůžeš s jeho řešením.

- Budeš se podílet na zavádění nápravných opatření, aby se stejné problémy zbytečně neopakovaly.

- Čeká Tě práce přímo v provozu skladu, včetně chladírenských prostor.

Hodíš se k nám, pokud:

- máš smysl pro detail a přesnost,

- je na tebe spoleh a umíš dodržovat nastavené postupy,

- dokážeš jasně komunikovat a upozornit na problém,

- nevadí Ti směnný provoz,

- zvládneš práci ve skladovém prostředí včetně chladnějších prostor,

- poradíš si s mobilem, aplikacemi a jednoduchým zadáváním dat,

- a umíš fungovat jako součást týmu.

Co je výhodou, ale ne podmínkou

- SŠ vzdělání v oblasti potravinářství, zemědělství nebo příbuzném oboru.

- Zkušenost ze skladu, maloobchodu, potravinářské výroby nebo kontroly kvality.

- Základní znalost angličtiny.

Co Ti nabízíme:

- Rohlík Xtra účet zdarma - nakupování s 10% cashbackem v podobě kreditů na další nákupy.

- Možnost placeného volna - čas na pořádný odpočinek a regeneraci.

- Dotované obědy & občerstvení zdarma - dobré jídlo, skvělá káva a čerstvé ovoce přímo na pracovišti každý den.

- Příspěvek na ošatné - 86 Kč navíc ke každé odpracované směně.

- Systém odměn za pochvaly - sbírání hvězdiček od kolegů a jejich výměna za vouchery do Alzy, Notina a dalších e-shopů.

- Multisport karta - příspěvek na sport i zasloužený relax po práci.

- Fajn firemní akce - společné oslavy úspěchů a neformální večírky.

Proč právě tahle práce?

Výsledek svojí práce uvidíš každý den. Pomáháš rozhodovat o tom, jaké zboží se dostane až k zákazníkovi. Když něco není v pořádku, máš možnost to zachytit dřív, než produkt opustí sklad.

Hledáme někoho, komu záleží na tom, aby věci byly udělané správně - protože právě díky takovým lidem můžeme zákazníkům doručovat potraviny v kvalitě, kterou od Rohlíku očekávají.

title: Head of Sales @Pelagon (backed by Hexa)
description:
WHO ARE WE?

The sea is the physical layer of the economy: our energy, data and trade move across it and under it. It is also Europe's most exposed flank. Cheap underwater drones, divers and mines now threaten ports, naval bases, subsea cables and offshore energy sites, and most of what is funded today stops at detection: it tells you a drone has entered the harbour, not how to stop it before it reaches the hull or the cable.

Pelagon is creating the category of maritime interdiction: detection and action together. We design, deploy and operate protection zones around critical maritime infrastructure: a persistent sensing network running our own acoustic-first AI detects and classifies threats, and an underwater interceptor acts on them.

We sell to navies and coast guards, and to the civilian operators of ports, subsea cables and offshore energy.

Pelagon was founded by Aymeric de Pontbriand (serial deeptech entrepreneur, founded and exited Scortex) and Gauthier Bouxin (French Navy officer, then McKinsey). A team is already in place around them: a lead embedded systems engineer, a lead hardware engineer and an a chief of staff. We are backed by Hexa http://hexa.cc/, the pioneer startup studio in Europe behind Front, Aircall and Spendesk.

⚡ WHAT IS AT STAKE IN THE COMING MONTHS

- Confirm the technology at sea with navies and operators.

- Deploy and sign our first paid pilots.

- Sign our first contracts.

By joining us, you'll play a key role in turning that early traction into multi-year protection contracts, and in building the sales team that follows.

🎯 YOUR MISSION

- Own every deal from first meeting to signed contract, with navies, port authorities and operators of cables and offshore energy.

- Sell interdiction, not detection alone: make the threat and the gap between alarm and response concrete for each buyer, then turn pilots into multi-year protection contracts.

- Shape requirements before the tender: work with navies and operators months ahead of an RFP so that it asks for detection and action together.

- Open our priority export markets: the Baltic and the Nordics, the Black Sea, the Gulf and Southeast Asia.

- Work as a pair with Gauthier, our Co-CEO, on key accounts, and bring Aymeric and the engineers in when the technical conversation starts.

- Build the partner channel: primes and integrators, offshore and cable operators, and local partners in each country.

- Turn every deployment into a reference the next customer can check.

- Set up the sales machine, then hire and lead the first sellers.

📈 HOW YOU WILL BE MEASURED

- First 3 months: you own the pipeline, have a qualified deal plan for each priority region, and a first paid pilot or LOI is signed.

- 6 months: paid pilots are running and the first contracts are signed.

- 12 months: recurring contracts in at least two countries, and your first sales hires are made and ramped.

🤩 THIS JOB IS YOUR DREAM JOB IF:

- You have closed defense or government deals and want to do it again, from zero, where every contract changes the trajectory

- You like being the second half of a founder pair: the CEO brings operational credibility, you bring the deal

- You'd rather be on a plane to Tallinn, Constanța or Abu Dhabi than in a forecast meeting

- You speak engineer well enough to sell sensors, AI and C2

- You want to write the sales playbook yourself, then hire the team that runs it

🙅 THIS JOB IS NOT FOR YOU IF:

- You need a brand, a marketing team and SDRs to sell

- You have only sold short-cycle SaaS or SMB deals, never through formal procurement

- You want to manage a large team from day one rather than close deals yourself

- Sales cycles of 12 to 24 months and 40% travel put you off

- You are looking for the comfort of a large defense group

WHAT WE OFFER

- A founding role in a seed-stage defense tech company backed by Hexa

- Fixed salary, variable on signed revenue, BSPCE

- Offices in Paris, real deployments at sea

title: Sales Representative (m/w/d) Quereinstieg - Uri
description:
Du hast noch nie im B2B-Vertrieb gearbeitet, möchtest aber gerne alle wichtigen Werkzeuge erlernen, um so richtig durchzustarten? Bei Salonkee lernst du den Vertrieb von Grund auf kennen und baust dir in Uri dein eigenes Netzwerk auf.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du verantwortest das Wachstum in deiner Region und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson vor Ort

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Deine Woche planst du eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Vertriebserfahrung ist nicht unbedingt notwendig. Wenn du aus dem Hospitality, Beauty, Retail, Fitness, Event oder einem anderen Bereich mit viel Kundenkontakt kommst, bringst du das Wichtigste schon mit.

- Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch - egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

- Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

- Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist strukturiert, organisiert und sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Vertrieb von Grund auf lernen: Bootcamp zum Start, gezieltes Ramp-Up Programm, Shadowing bei erfahrenen Kolleg:innen, Roleplays und regelmäßiges Coaching.

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: von Junior über Senior bis hin zu Führungsrollen.

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: Lead Product Manager, Connectivity / Gateways
description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

Verkada's Connectivity products secure people and property in remote and edge environments. Our Cellular and Wi-Fi Gateways bring Verkada's full platform including threat detection, deterrence, and real-time visibility, anywhere it's needed. Verkada Gateways enable cameras, intercoms, access control, and sensors to be deployed in locations without stable internet or power.

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own and grow Verkada's Gateway product line. In this role, your mission is twofold: make gateways the enabling layer that unlocks every unwired Verkada deployment, and build the product depth and business model that grows Gateway into a flagship product.

What You'll Do

• Own strategy and execution for Verkada's Gateway product line

• Own and expand the gateway roadmap across reliability, fleet-scale cloud management, and new connectivity options and form factors.

• Partner with product lines across Verkada (remote cameras, security trailers, transportation, intercoms, access) to deliver connectivity-as-a-service and drive ecosystem attach

• Define data plan and pricing strategy that improves both customer adoption and Verkada margin

What You Bring

• 5+ years of experience in product management, preferably in B2B networking, connectivity, embedded systems, or IoT

• Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or similar quantitative field. MS, PhD, or MBA optional

• Proven history of launching and scaling products and businesses. Strong customer intuition, technical depth, and ability to navigate tradeoffs are critical to success in this role.

• Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (LTE/5G, Wi-Fi, WAN failover, SIM/carrier management), plus foundational knowledge of firmware, device bring-up, and hardware design

• Ability to build platform and recurring-revenue business models, with a structured approach to ambiguous problems like data plan pricing, carrier economics, attach-rate modeling, and ROI analysis

• Excited to roll up your sleeves and get out of the office. You'll spend time with installers, integrators, and customers deploying in unwired environments. You’ll use that insight to shape the product

Employee Benefits

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

• Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs. Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans

• Nationwide medical, vision, and dental coverage

• Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexib

title: Production Editor
description:
Production Editor
Location: Remote
A production editor serves in a variety of capacities to prepare editorial content for Hearst Newspapers print editions, including:

• Page layout and section organization

• Wire news decision-making

• Copy editing for print

• Page editing, including headline and caption writing, photo selection and trimming stories to fit.

• Proofing pages

• Typesetting pages in time for deadline.

Depending on the size of the newspaper, depth of editing and other factors, the production editor may perform all of these tasks for a page, set of pages or a section; or play one or two of these roles on a section or set of pages. Often, production editors will serve in one or two of these roles for part of a shift, and in other sets of these roles for another part of the shift.
Being flexible, adaptable and able to flex between the roles and vary the depth of editing and finishing is a crucial part of this role.
Key qualifications

• Page layout and section organization.

• Copy editing, including headline writing and caption writing

• Savvy to finish and typeset a page on time

• Experience in print news production

• Ability to work with multiple products and multiple people with a customer-service focus.

Specialty Skills

• Newspaper editing, headline writing and caption writing

• Aptitude in sports story and page editing a plus

• Newspaper page proofing

• Excellent literacy in English

• CUE/CCI experience plus.

Special to this role
While we are looking for editors who can work across topics, this role will primarily be focused on editing and presenting sports news in the Hearst papers throughout Texas, especially focused on Dallas, Houston, San Antonio and Austin.
As such, sports journalism is a specialty sill that is necessary for success, as will the ability to work in other parts of the operation outside of sports.
About Hearst Newspapers:
With 2,500 employees across the nation, HNP encompasses a network of 24 daily and 52 weekly publications, including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News and Albany Times Union, several top digital-only news and lifestyle sites, marketing services businesses, and entertainment businesses such as King Features Syndicate.
At HNP , we are investing in new and innovative ways to tell stories - growing newsrooms, diversifying tools, evolving platforms - to support the millions of people who trust us each month to help them make decisions, take action and be inspired.
Be a part of something bigger - your headline awaits.

title: Federal Capture Director (Contract) - McLean, VA
description:

This engagement is for the operator who knows how to walk a federal opportunity from first signal through awarded contract, and who wants to build that function inside a firm where it does not exist yet.

The Wilkinson Firm is a workforce strategy and staffing firm headquartered across NC and Atlanta. We launched in April 2025 and are now in Year 2 of operations. Two operational divisions today (HR Advisory for the mental health industry, Premium Hospitality and Event Staffing). Government Contracting division being formally stood up this quarter. • Capture-to-proposal lifecycle: opportunity assessment, teaming strategy, technical and price strategy, color-team reviews, submission readiness

Engagement is hourly. Time commitment scales with pipeline activity, typically 10-40 hours per week. Win-based bonus stack negotiable on top of hourly rate for awarded contracts the engagement materially drove.
